name: Ostra
description: A sun-washed, room-first template for boutique hotels, inns, and guesthouses — rose-plaster canvas, oxblood ink and one claret accent, the house's name set huge across a full-bleed photograph, every room hung with its own key-fob tag, a front-desk card for check-in and breakfast, a what's-nearby list with walking times, and a check-availability call to action under a striped awning.
